Pointing Your Custom Domain

To use your own domain name, update the DNS records at your domain registrar.

  • Create an A record for the root domain pointing to the IP address shown in your account.
  • Create a CNAME record for www pointing to the root domain.

DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate. The SSL certificate is issued automatically after the domain resolves.
